newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Mentor upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Mentor upgraded to buy.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth healthcare products analyst Parice Halbert said she upgraded Mentor Corp to buy from hold.
--Shares in the medical devices maker were up 1/8 to 23-3/4.

--She said she made the move based on "a strong reception to Mentor's new ultrasound assisted liposuction system at (Sunday's) opening day of the 65th Annual American Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons meeting, favorable indications from the (U.S.) Food and Drug Administration and ... other factors."
